C1596.title: Zhang Junjie et al. Illegal Control of Computer Information Systems Case
C1596.summary: Starting July 2017, defendants Zhang Junjie, Peng Linglong, Zhu Dong, and Jiang Yuhao conspired in Malaysia to exploit vulnerable target servers by implanting Trojan programs (backdoors), gaining backend access and uploading gambling advertisement webpages.
